I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or seeds from the agro-dealer, so I will use manure from our animals to feed this small plot. The rains have been enough here in the North Central, so I will not irrigate; I will plant the same cassava and yam stems we kept from last season's harvest. Weeding and harvesting will be done by me and my family, as the land is too small to waste money on hired labor. I do not use sprays on my crops because they are too costly and I do not know which ones are safe.
